A.schemaImpact: Flyway history and release baseline are validated; no schema change is implied by the control.
A.apiImpact: Configuration and release gates; no business endpoint authority is added.
A.uiImpact: Readiness and configuration state only; no client-side authority.
A.rollback: Fail closed and retain the previous verified release.

B.schemaImpact: PostgreSQL roles, grants, tenant predicates and fixed function search_path.
B.apiImpact: Authentication, role, tenant and object-scope enforcement on protected endpoints.
B.uiImpact: Unauthorized actions are hidden but server authorization remains authoritative.
B.rollback: Disable affected workflow and restore the last verified role/grant policy.

C.schemaImpact: No direct migration requirement; durable replay/rate-limit ledgers remain server owned.
C.apiImpact: Headers, CORS, bearer boundary, validation, SSRF controls, rate limits and safe problems.
C.uiImpact: Safe rendering and actionable, non-sensitive error/retry behavior.
C.rollback: Block the affected route/integration and preserve correlated evidence.

D.schemaImpact: No business schema change; committed inputs and artifacts are provenance-bound.
D.apiImpact: Production secrets are server-only and missing controls fail closed.
D.uiImpact: No secret or provider credential may enter browser artifacts.
D.rollback: Revoke/rotate credentials and redeploy the last verified artifacts.

E.schemaImpact: Artifact classification, quarantine, lineage and access records are durable.
E.apiImpact: Upload, scan, download and export authorization is rechecked server-side.
E.uiImpact: Quarantine, masking, expiry and correction lineage are explicit.
E.rollback: Quarantine artifacts, revoke capabilities and retain prior immutable evidence.

F.schemaImpact: Append-only audit, retention schedule and legal-hold records.
F.apiImpact: Audited retention/hold commands require scoped authority and concurrency control.
F.uiImpact: Retention and hold state is visible without exposing restricted payloads.
F.rollback: Stop deletion jobs and append compensating control facts; never rewrite audit.

G.schemaImpact: Durable outbox, retry, checkpoint and dead-letter state is preserved.
G.apiImpact: Health and diagnostics distinguish mandatory failure from optional degradation.
G.uiImpact: Provider freshness, fallback and recovery state are explicit.
G.rollback: Pause workers/providers, preserve checkpoints and replay only with authority.

H.schemaImpact: Critical query plans/indexes and concurrency invariants are measured.
H.apiImpact: Capacity and latency budgets cover critical mutations, lists and workers.
H.uiImpact: Critical flows retain responsiveness under the defined local profiles.
H.rollback: Hold rollout when budgets fail and restore the prior compatible artifact.

I.schemaImpact: None; compatibility coverage must not alter persisted semantics.
I.apiImpact: Date, timezone and UTF-8 contracts remain stable.
I.uiImpact: WCAG, keyboard, responsive and supported-browser critical flows.
I.rollback: Disable the affected UI release while keeping compatible APIs available.

J.schemaImpact: Full Flyway restore validation plus row, hold, lineage and checksum reconciliation.
J.apiImpact: Restored services must revalidate access before traffic.
J.uiImpact: No user flow resumes until restore reconciliation passes.
J.rollback: Isolate the failed restore and retain the source backup and previous environment.

K.schemaImpact: Expand/contract compatibility and migration rehearsal govern deployment.
K.apiImpact: Server-authoritative flags, canary checks and post-deploy regression.
K.uiImpact: Cohort visibility follows server state; UI flags grant no authority.
K.rollback: Disable flags/integrations, restore the prior artifact and reconcile new events.

L.schemaImpact: Documentation and final evidence must identify the exact production Flyway chain.
L.apiImpact: Swagger, code documentation and operational contracts are release checked.
L.uiImpact: Persona guides and functional flows are versioned with the release.
L.rollback: Keep NO-GO until evidence, training, approvals and rollback criteria are complete.
